I got mine through https://80percentarms.com . They also sell a jig to complete it. All you need is:

A drill press. A drill will work fine but a press is a lot easier. I got one from harbor freight for like 50 bucks i think. Did just fine.

Router. Do not get one from harbor freight. You want one that locks into place well once you set the depth of the bit.

3/8'', 5/32'' and 19/64'' drill bits. The 3/8'' does need to be set for a specific depth. You can play around with the drill press and get it perfect but the jig does have a depth gauge made into it for that bit . I just stuck the bit in the gauge and tack welded a 3/8'' washer to it. Bada bing bada boom

And a routing bit. Which I would get off of their website, works great.

Also a vice does come in handy but i did it without one. Which was kinda gay, a vice is much nicer.

Yea that's just for necessary tools. The process is pretty damn simple. For the drilling, well, just drill holes where it tells you to on the jig.

The milling isn't complicated either. The main thing is to keep the router from grabbing and trying to jump the fuck out of your hands. Only remove small amounts per pass, probably like 1/8" increments in depth of your bit, and go slow. Once you've done a few passes and got it down it's just time consuming. Took me a few sittings to remove all the material from the trigger well.

Then drill the trigger hole and oblong it with the router. Go reeeal slow here so that you don't get a little womp in the trigger hole like I got. Or worse and really fuck it up.
